note: Download and open in Google Colab or a local Jupyter environment. These packs are online/local only; the app kernel never downloads them.

notebooks.title: Scikit-learn classification pack — breast cancer
notebooks.intro: Canonical Breast Cancer Wisconsin data par leakage-safe pipeline, logistic regression, random forest, cross-validation aur permutation importance. Colab ya local environment ke liye; offline Code Bro kernel me sklearn bundled nahi hai.

notebooks.title: Trees and XGBoost classifiers — iris
notebooks.intro: Canonical Iris data par decision tree, random forest aur XGBoost classifier ka same-split comparison, depth sweep, confusion matrix aur feature importance.

notebooks.title: XGBoost regression pack — diabetes progression
notebooks.intro: Canonical Diabetes progression data par linear baseline, random forest aur XGBoost regressor, MAE/RMSE/R², residuals aur feature importance. Colab ya local environment ke liye.
